pump: Include minimum, normal and peak flow; distinguish delivered flow from displacement × speed.
Give normal/peak pressure, hours per day, start/stop frequency and standby state.
Specify chemistry, temperature range, inlet pressure at flow, filtration and shutdown/freeze conditions.
Speed, rotation, motor supply/frequency, coupling, port standard, footprint and drawing requirements.
cylinder: Extension/retraction loads, linkage geometry, friction, acceleration and holding duty.
Stroke, bore/rod candidates, mounting, side loads, buckling length and available space.
Pressure at both ports, cycle time, flow, cushioning and speed control.
Required state on power/pressure loss, water quality, temperature, seal and corrosion conditions.
valve: Direction, pressure, flow or load-holding job; normal, commanded and failure states.
Flow range, upstream/downstream pressure, allowable loss, water temperature and fluid.
Manual, hydraulic pilot or electrical; pilot differential, voltage/frequency, signal, connector and enclosure.
Port/manifold pattern, materials, leakage requirement, response time, setting and test conditions.
motor: Starting, running, reversing and holding duty; minimum/maximum speed and cycles.
Flow, pressure differential, outlet/backpressure, case-drain conditions and water.
Coupling, radial/axial loads, alignment, flange, footprint and mechanical restraints.
Speed/torque control, safe stop, overspeed protection, thermal limits and test evidence.
hpu: Movement, holding, standby and fault states; actuators, simultaneous demand and cycle times.
Voltage, phase, frequency, fault level, enclosure, ambient range, working water and available space.
Pump/motor/reservoir/filtration/manifold; PLC/I/O, wiring, installation, approval and integrator responsibilities.
Flushing, acceptance tests, operator instruction, isolation, spares, maintenance access and support.
ro: Feed flow, permeate flow, recovery ratio, salinity, temperature and membrane pressure loss.
Pressure and speed range; inlet pressure at flow, filtration, water chemistry and shutdown state.
Pretreatment/feed pump, Power Centre, membranes, controls, flushing and product-water responsibilities.
Exact configuration, curves, interfaces, measured input per product-water volume and included auxiliaries.
pilot: One bounded application, the current problem and the decision the trial must support.
Equivalent useful output, energy, leakage, availability, water use, maintenance and agreed pass/fail limits.
Host, supplier, integrator, operator, equipment, installation, measurements, approvals, funding and ownership.
Bench check, representative duty, site trial, fault tests, review dates and conditions for stopping or expanding.
wastewater: Identify gate/valve/actuator, hydraulic supply, controls, sensing and any software requirement separately.
Loads, flow/head, I/O, protocol, tag list, utilities, network, drawings and operating sequence.
Identify existing equipment, proposed engineering, third-party software, licences, hosting, access and data owner.
Test normal/fault states; provide configuration, drawings, asset list, training, backups and support responsibility.
fittings: Thread standard, nominal size, gender, sealing face, tube/pipe dimensions and existing part reference.
Medium, normal/maximum pressure and temperature, chemicals, corrosion exposure and cleaning.
Manufacturer/part number, current drawing, pressure-temperature rating, material records and quantity.
Assembly instructions, compatibility, required date, location and traceability/inspection requirements.
ownership: Same useful duty, operating life, installation, approvals and support responsibilities for both options.
Currency/base date, capital, installation, energy, water, consumables, labour, maintenance and downtime.
Measured versus assumed inputs, source/date, low/base/high cases and excluded consequences.
Discount rate, analysis period, residual value, confirmed assistance and decision threshold; keep incident scenarios separate.
maintenance: Tag, exact model/configuration, drawings, manufacturer procedure and normal operating measurements.
Water/filter state, leakage, pressure/flow/temperature trends, rod/hose condition and alarm history.
Isolation, stored energy, parts, tools, competency, service access and permissible outage.
Flushing/venting, functional/fault checks, record changes, sign-off and next inspection requirements.
general: What moves or needs pressure, where it operates and what problem should be solved.
Load, movement, flow, pressure, timing, temperature, working water and environmental exposure.
Equipment, electrical/controls interfaces, approval route and responsibilities inside/outside the enquiry.
Drawings, calculations, budget basis, acceptance criteria, schedule and service requirements.
